name: Ano, Itsumo Akarukute Genki na Oba-san ga, Kusogaki ni Mesuinu Choukyou Sarete Jukujo Kei Ero Zasshi de Ikigao o Sarasu Nante...
original_name: あの、いつも明るくて元気なオバさんが、クソガキにメス犬調教されて熟女系エロ雑誌でイキ顔を晒すなんて…
source:
Teruo is secretly in love with his aunt Sanae, since she always protected him when he was little and bullied in school.

One day Kaito, one of the bullies from his chieldhood, shows up in front Teruo and demands a large sum of money from him.
Teruo, who tries to graduate from his worthless former self, declines and even tries to fight back.

Kaito backs away but threatens that Teruo will regret his actions.
In the following days his aunt's behaviour gradually begins to change...
translation:
中岛照夫一直暗恋姨母相泽早苗。小时候在学校受欺负时，早苗总会保护他。

某天，童年时欺负过他的山际海斗再次出现，向照夫索要一大笔钱。照夫想与过去那个一无是处的自己彻底告别，不但拒绝要求，还试图反抗。

海斗暂时退去，却威胁照夫一定会为此后悔。接下来的日子里，早苗的行为逐渐发生变化……
